tools.name: docs_list
tools.description: List or full-text search Transcend documentation. Pick the narrowest argument you can: use route when you know the Admin Dashboard page the user is on ("this page"); it returns that page's docs, then more docs for its product. Otherwise use product when you know the product area. Otherwise use query, which ranks articles by title and body and returns snippets. route and product can each be combined with query. section alone lists one llms.txt section; with no arguments the tool returns the section names. Pick the best matching url, then call docs_fetch.

route.description: Find docs for an Admin Dashboard page. Accepts a route pattern, a concrete path ('/privacy-center/general-settings/deployment'), or a full app URL. Returns pages about that page, then pages that link to it, then the page's product docs. Can combine with query. Not with section or product.

product.description: List docs for one product, overview pages first. One of: Assessments, Classification, Consent Management, Data Inventory, DSR Automation, Platform, Preference Management, Privacy Center, System Discovery, Web Auditor (case-insensitive). Can combine with query. Not with section or route.

section.description: List the articles in this llms.txt section (exact match). Omit both arguments to see the available section names.

query.description: Full-text search terms. Prefer the two or three most distinctive words for the topic over a whole sentence, since common words match most articles and blur the ranking. At most 20 results come back and there is no paging, so narrow the terms rather than expecting to page.

tools.name: docs_fetch
tools.description: Fetch full markdown content for a Transcend documentation article by URL. Use urls returned by docs_list.

url.description: Absolute https URL of a docs.transcend.io article (.md) from docs_list.
